Hey Jordan! 👋 Glad to see you online. I was just reviewing the latest build logs for the v2.4 release and wanted to sync up with you before we hit the final push tonight.

I’ve been digging into some of the dependency conflicts we flagged yesterday—pretty tricky stuff, but I think I’ve got a clean resolution that should save us some headache during the deployment window. How’s your side of the codebase looking? Ready to crush this deadline together? 🚀
